annotations.title: Customs entry pre-check: HTS lines read from the current HTSUS, country and unit checks, and whether CPSC certificate data must be eFiled with the entry (signed)

description: Customs entry pre-check and CPSC eFiling, for wholesalers importing and their brokers' agents: before the entry is filed, send each entry line (HTS number, description, country of origin, unit, and what you know about CPSC: regulated yes/no/unknown, CPC or GCC, full data or a Product Registry reference). Get back, per line, the HTS line as read from the USITC HTS search service (read now or from a cache of up to 24 hours, read_at stated; official description, general rate, units, footnotes; or the valid 10-digit numbers when you sent 8 digits), unit and country checks, and whether 16 CFR 1110.13 needs CPSC certificate data eFiled with this entry (from 8 Jul 2026; from 8 Jan 2027 for foreign trade zone entries) and whether what you have is enough. Each issue is fix, ask or check. Free. No model, nothing stored, signed record with the HTS revision read. Up to 25 lines per call. Plain ASCII text only. Not legal advice: it does not classify goods, compute duty or extra tariffs, decide which CPSC rules apply, read CBP's flag list, file anything or build the certificate data itself. Docs: https://llpro.ai/customs-entry-pre-check-and-cpsc

date.description: Planned entry date (arrival date for mail), YYYY-MM-DD, 2020-01-01 to one year ahead.

type.description: consumption, warehouse, ftz (entered from a foreign trade zone), de_minimis, or mail.

country_of_origin.description: ISO 3166-1 two-letter code, e.g. CN, VN, MX, US.

certificate.description: CPC = Children's Product Certificate; GCC = General Certificate of Conformity.

certificate_id.description: The Product Registry certificate identifier, when filing is reference. Checked for form only; never echoed, only hashed into the record.

filing.description: full = all certificate data in the PGA Message Set; reference = the certificate is in CPSC's Product Registry and the entry refers to it.

regulated.description: Is the product subject to a CPSC rule, ban, standard or regulation that needs a certificate? The tool does not decide this.

description.description: Your plain description of the goods (no names, emails or ID numbers).

hts.description: HTSUS number, 10 digits for the entry (dots and spaces allowed), e.g. '9503.00.0073'. 8 digits gets the list of valid 10-digit numbers.

line.description: Your line label, e.g. '1' or 'A'. No names or ID numbers.

unit.description: The unit of quantity you will report, e.g. 'No.', 'prs.', 'kg', 'doz.'.
